title: 第六十四章 太强了（求订阅）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

中年男子沉默了一会，突然身上黑气缭绕，那些黑色气息自动格挡袭来的苍炎。

同时一个特殊灰色领域，跟着扩散开来。

一股狂暴无比的气息，顿时乍现。

在场所有人都被笼罩了进去，四周场景发生了翻天腹地变化。原本十分狭小的场地，现在顿时变得无比开阔。在远处尽头，无数高墙升起，整个领域如同一个竞技场。

领域里开始出现一条巨龙，很快无限膨胀变大，长出龙爪，龙脚和龙翼。最后变成参天耸立的六头怪物，俯视着叶落。

“是领域之力，看来天域级强者果然不是那么好打的。”叶落清晰地感知到周围已经对自己产生了压制力。

”轰——“

青色的苍炎燃烧在领域之中，但却没有什么效果。一些龙头朝着叶落喷出黑色炎火，一些龙头张开血盆大口咬下去。

叶落闪避开攻击，挥动重剑凌厉劈在巨龙的脑袋。

”咔！“

巨大反震力，震得叶落差点没握住天谴剑。

叶落心一惊，不过还没等他诧异完。一个龙头蛮狠撞了过来，径直撞在叶落的身上。

叶落就像巨锤砸中胸口一样，重重飞了出去，落在地上。

“轰隆——”

叶落只感到自己胸口的肋骨都断了几根，这只巨龙的每一击都有着能和自己相匹敌的力量。

周围领域里面，黑色雾气夹杂着黑色火焰逐渐将叶落包围。

叶落虽然被包围了，但是他并不畏惧。其实自己的实力也没有完全发挥出来。

“哼！这么淡定？！看样子是不畏惧我了？那我就让你知道什么叫真正的绝望。”

眼前的中年男子顿时被激怒了，他感觉被叶落藐视了。

紧接着中年男子手中出现了一枚符石爆发出璀璨的光晕，朝着叶落扩散过去。

叶落下意识幻化冰盾格挡，可是光晕从他身上扫过去，没有感觉任何不适。

............

就在叶落感觉十分狐疑的时候。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The middle-aged man was silent for a while, and suddenly his body was filled with black energy, which automatically blocked the incoming blue flames.

At the same time, a special gray area spread.

An extremely violent aura suddenly appeared.

Everyone present was enveloped, and the surrounding scene changed drastically.The originally very small venue now suddenly became extremely open.At the far end, countless high walls rise, and the entire field is like an arena.

A giant dragon began to appear in the field, and soon it expanded infinitely, growing claws, feet and wings.Finally, it turned into a towering six-headed monster, looking down at the fallen leaves.

"It's the power of the domain. It seems that the powerful people at the Tianyu level are not that easy to fight." Ye Luo clearly felt that the surrounding people had suppressed him.

"Boom——"

Cyan flames burned in the field, but it had no effect.Some dragon heads sprayed black flames towards the leaves, and some opened their bloody mouths to bite them.

Ye Luodian avoided the attack and swung his heavy sword to hit the dragon's head sharply.

"Click!"

The huge repulsive force shook Ye Luo to the point where he almost lost his grip on the Heavenly Punishment Sword.

Ye Luo was shocked, but before he could finish his surprise.A dragon's head came over very hard and hit Ye Luo's body directly.

Like a giant hammer hitting his chest, Ye Luo flew out heavily and landed on the ground.

"Boom——"

Ye Luo felt that several ribs on his chest were broken. Every blow of this giant dragon had a power that could rival his own.

In the surrounding area, black mist mixed with black flames gradually surrounded Ye Luo.

Although Ye Luo was surrounded, he was not afraid.In fact, his own strength has not been fully utilized.

"Hmph! So calm?! It seems like you are not afraid of me anymore? Then I will let you know what true despair is."

The middle-aged man in front of him was immediately angered. He felt despised by Ye Luo.

Immediately afterwards, a rune stone appeared in the middle-aged man's hand and a bright halo burst out, spreading towards Ye Luo.

Ye Luo subconsciously turned into an ice shield to block, but the halo swept over him without feeling any discomfort.

............

Just when Ye Luo felt very suspicious.
